Detailed Description

Symmetric cross-fade between two sources.

Cross fades between two SoundEvent objects; the time of cross-fade alters the individual life times of the objects.

void CrossFade::update ( Subject *  s  )  [virtual]

This class removes from the formal interface the method 'update' by defining it.

In this way the derived classes must not implement this method; this because in the tick () function of the derived classes should be present some objects of type SoundObject which should manage the update method.

Reimplemented from SoundEvent.
